tasks.title: Set up development environment
tasks.description: Create .venv and install Swingcut with development dependencies.

tasks.title: Configure Gemini API key
tasks.description: Use the authenticated gcloud project to create a Gemini-restricted key and store it outside the repository with mode 0600.

tasks.title: Run doctor
tasks.description: Check local macOS, Python, FFmpeg, Swift, and Gemini-key readiness without uploading media.

tasks.title: Run all checks
tasks.description: Run lint, formatting checks, Python and Swift tests, and builds.

tasks.title: Build signed Photos helper app
tasks.description: Build and sign the LaunchServices app bundle used for PhotoKit authorization.

tasks.title: Run PhotoKit bridge smoke test
tasks.description: Build the Swift bridge and verify its versioned executable.
